style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render placed in an empty white space. Figures are smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and gray, only the key objects in red. 1940s-1970s Italian period details.
avoid_en: logos, badges or emblems of real companies (no bull emblem, no prancing horse emblem), car brand names, readable text or numbers, license plates with characters, detailed national flags, blood, faces resembling real people

ferruccio.desc_en: the tractor maker, a stocky middle-aged man figurine with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short slicked-back dark hair, a thin dark mustache shape, a plain brown leather jacket over a white open-collar shirt, dark gray trousers

enzo.desc_en: the racing car boss, a tall elderly man figurine with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), swept-back white hair, dark sunglasses, a plain dark gray double-breasted suit, no badges

engineers.desc_en: the three young engineers, three slim young man figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short dark hair, plain white short-sleeved shirts, dark trousers, no badges or text

cuts.image: 白い空間で、赤い低いスポーツカーと、赤い1950年代のクーペの模型が、同じ高さの台に並んでいる
cuts.image_en: Two pedestals of equal height in the white space: on one the very low flat red 1966 mid-engine car model, on the other the red 1950s coupe model. Both lit equally. No badges.
cuts.en: Two pedestals of equal height in the white space: on one the very low flat red 1966 mid-engine car model, on the other the red 1950s coupe model. Both lit equally. No badges.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、革のジャンパーの男のフィギュアが、赤いトラクターの列の前に立っている
cuts.image_en: the tractor maker standing in front of long rows of small boxy red farm tractor models with no badges in the white space, hands on hips.
cuts.en: the tractor maker standing in front of long rows of small boxy red farm tractor models with no badges in the white space, hands on hips.

cuts.image: 白い空間の地図の模型で、南米の内陸の国から、ヨーロッパへ赤い糸が伸びている（文字は無い）
cuts.image_en: A plain relief globe-like map model in the white space showing South America and Europe, with a long red thread stretching from the middle of South America across the ocean to Italy. No labels, no borders drawn.
cuts.en: A plain relief globe-like map model in the white space showing South America and Europe, with a long red thread stretching from the middle of South America across the ocean to Italy. No labels, no borders drawn.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、南米の政府の建物の模型。前に軍服のフィギュアが並び、門が閉じている（旗は無い）
cuts.image_en: A government palace building model in the white space with soldier figurines in plain olive uniforms lined up in front of its closed gate. No flags, no emblems, no weapons fired.
cuts.en: A government palace building model in the white space with soldier figurines in plain olive uniforms lined up in front of its closed gate. No flags, no emblems, no weapons fired.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、2本の赤い糸が、はさみの模型で切られている
cuts.image_en: Two red threads stretched across the white space being cut by a large pair of scissors model, the cut ends falling. Dramatic.
cuts.en: Two red threads stretched across the white space being cut by a large pair of scissors model, the cut ends falling. Dramatic.

cuts.image: 白い空間の港の模型。岸壁に赤いトラクターの模型がずらりと並んだまま、船は来ない
cuts.image_en: A harbor quay diorama in the white space: hundreds of small red farm tractor models lined up on the dock, waiting, with empty water and no ship. Gray overcast light.
cuts.en: A harbor quay diorama in the white space: hundreds of small red farm tractor models lined up on the dock, waiting, with empty water and no ship. Gray overcast light.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、トラクター工場の模型が、大きな手の形の模型に持ち上げられて運ばれていく
cuts.image_en: The red tractor factory building model being lifted away by a large plain white mannequin-like hand model in the white space. Symbolic.
cuts.en: The red tractor factory building model being lifted away by a large plain white mannequin-like hand model in the white space. Symbolic.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、円の形の模型が赤い部分と灰色の部分に分かれ、赤い部分が少し大きい
cuts.image_en: A large round pie-shaped model in the white space split into two slices, the red slice slightly larger than half, the gray slice slightly smaller, the red slice sliding away. No numbers.
cuts.en: A large round pie-shaped model in the white space split into two slices, the red slice slightly larger than half, the gray slice slightly smaller, the red slice sliding away. No numbers.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、ガソリンを入れる昔の機械の模型の前に、赤いスポーツカーが止まり、まわりは空っぽ
cuts.image_en: An old 1970s fuel pump model in the white space with an empty hose, and a very low red sports car model parked in front of it, with no other cars around. Empty, gloomy light. No text.
cuts.en: An old 1970s fuel pump model in the white space with an empty hose, and a very low red sports car model parked in front of it, with no other cars around. Empty, gloomy light. No text.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、湖のほとりのぶどう畑のジオラマ。畑の中に、革のジャンパーの男のフィギュアが立っている
cuts.image_en: A lakeside vineyard diorama in the white space: gentle hills of grapevines sloping down to a calm lake, and the tractor maker standing among the vines holding a small basket of grapes. Warm sunset light.
cuts.en: A lakeside vineyard diorama in the white space: gentle hills of grapevines sloping down to a calm lake, and the tractor maker standing among the vines holding a small basket of grapes. Warm sunset light.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、ぶどうの房とワインの瓶の模型が、小さな台の上に置かれている（ラベルは無地）
cuts.image_en: A small wooden table in the white space with a bunch of dark grapes and a single plain wine bottle with a blank label. Quiet, soft evening light.
cuts.en: A small wooden table in the white space with a bunch of dark grapes and a single plain wine bottle with a blank label. Quiet, soft evening light.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、まったく同じ形の白い箱が2つ並び、片方にだけ赤い大きなリボンがかかっている
cuts.image_en: Two identical plain white boxes side by side in the white space; one is wrapped with a big shiny red ribbon, the other is plain. Same size, same shape.
cuts.en: Two identical plain white boxes side by side in the white space; one is wrapped with a big shiny red ribbon, the other is plain. Same size, same shape.

cuts.image: 白い空間の工場の模型から、同じ白い箱が流れ出て、途中で赤い箱と灰色の箱に分かれていく
cuts.image_en: A small factory model in the white space with a conveyor belt carrying identical white boxes out; at the end the line splits, some boxes become red, others gray, otherwise identical. No text.
cuts.en: A small factory model in the white space with a conveyor belt carrying identical white boxes out; at the end the line splits, some boxes become red, others gray, otherwise identical. No text.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、今の服装の人のフィギュアが、開けた箱の中をのぞきこんで首をかしげている
cuts.image_en: A figurine in modern casual clothes in the white space, peering into an opened white box with its head tilted, puzzled. Soft light.
cuts.en: A figurine in modern casual clothes in the white space, peering into an opened white box with its head tilted, puzzled. Soft light.
